title: Coupled field cubes with incremental inner updates

claims.statement: The explicit coupled field-cube encoder and its radius-72 two-search decoder, as specified for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses, have uniform-message average block error at most 55175264610327609/1000000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Check the field, all list budget tables, exact admitted shells, restricted double-direction imbalance, weighted single-direction removal, affine updates and exact worst-case primitive exponent.
